d: A village leader who loses a fight to his enemy Arumugam, causing the death of his lover Vijayalakshmi. Years later, another woman named Vijayalakshmi enters the village, and Chakkaravarthy defends her from Arumugam's goons, rekindling his fight for justice.

After the marriage of his daughter, Hridaynath lives a simple life with his unmarried daughter in Dehra Dun. His newly married daughter pays them a visit. She finds out that Hridaynath has debts and is in trouble.
Friends Rajiv and Amar go their separate ways after Seema decides to be with Amar rather than Rajiv. Years later, prosecution lawyer Amar is delighted to see Rajiv in court and accused of murder.
